title: Review of the Toner-Tu eating-flocks negative: on fresh seeds 5 and 6 the motile world becomes box-spanning travelling bands (3-4 components, 0 persistent splits) and the v0=0 twin makes 162-168 splitting Gray-Scott spots (55-67 persistent splits, generation 3); half the world step gives the same bands
summary: labkit at the finding's settings (128^2, 150 frames x 80 steps, t=3000): motile defaults (v0 0.25) on seeds 5 and 6 end with 3 and 4 components, 0 persistent tracks, 0 persistent splits; the sheet shows crescents at t~120 whose flanks grow into fronts by t~400 and align into parallel travelling bands by t~2000. The v0=0 twin on the same seeds: 168 and 162 spots, 156 and 150 persistent tracks, 67 and 55 persistent splits, generation 3. World dt halved (0.25 -> 0.125, 160 steps per frame, seed 5): 3 components at the end, 0 persistent splits, the same band state.

observations.M: pack/seed5/sheet.png: motile crescents at t=120 become fronts by t=400 and box-spanning bands by t=2000 (3 components at t=3000, 0 persistent tracks), so self-propulsion gives no motile individuals; pack_v0 (v0=0) keeps 162-168 still, splitting spots

controls_run.M: pack_v0/ (v0=0 twin, seeds 5 and 6) and pack_dthalf/ (world dt 0.125, seed 5)

verdicts.limitation: Only the default motile setting and its twin; I did not re-run the 14-setting screen or the density-dependent speed variant. 'Supported' means the negative result replicates.
